KISW.G1.KUANDI.T6_TAHAJIA_IMLA.IMLA.M1_T.help: Count the words aloud with a finger for each before writing.
KISW.G1.KUANDI.T6_TAHAJIA_IMLA.IMLA.M1_T.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G1.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_ZURI_NA_.V.error: Gives the adjective the people prefix whatever the noun (kiti mzuri).
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_ZURI_NA_.V.cause: Mzuri is the form the child hears most (mtoto mzuri) and is used everywhere.
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_ZURI_NA_.V.reveals: The question "Jaza: Kitabu ___ (-zuri)." with "mzuri" among the options.
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_ZURI_NA_.V.help: Match noun and adjective by colour: kiti kizuri, mtoto mzuri, vitu vizuri.
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_ZURI_NA_.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G1.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_ZURI_NA_.V.error: Gives an n-n noun the m- form of the adjective (nyumba mzuri for nyumba nzuri).
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_ZURI_NA_.V.cause: The n- prefix and its sound changes (nzuri, ndefu, nyeupe) are new to the child.
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_ZURI_NA_.V.reveals: The question "Jaza: Nguo ___ (-zuri)." with "mzuri" among the options.
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_ZURI_NA_.V.help: Read pairs aloud: nyumba nzuri, kalamu ndefu, nguo nyeupe.
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_ZURI_NA_.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G1.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_ZURI_NA_.V.error: Puts the adjective before the noun (mzuri mtoto), in English word order.
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_ZURI_NA_.V.cause: English puts the describing word first.
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_ZURI_NA_.V.reveals: The question "Ni lipi sahihi?" with "mzuri mtoto" among the options.
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_ZURI_NA_.V.help: Build with cards: noun first, then the adjective.
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_ZURI_NA_.V.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G1.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_ZURI_NA_.V.error: Leaves the adjective singular with a plural noun (watoto mzuri).
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_ZURI_NA_.V.cause: The child changes the noun only.
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_ZURI_NA_.V.reveals: The question "Jaza: Watoto ___ (-zuri)." with "mzuri" among the options.
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_ZURI_NA_.V.help: Change the noun to many and ask the child to change every word that goes with it.
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_ZURI_NA_.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G1.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_ZURI_NA_.V.error: Picks the opposite member of the pair (mrefu for a short person).

example.question: Picha inaonyesha meno machafu yenye mashimo. Meno ni ___.

KISW.G1.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_ZURI_NA_.V.cause: The pair is learnt together and the two words are swapped.
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_ZURI_NA_.V.reveals: The question "Picha inaonyesha meno machafu yenye mashimo. Meno ni ___." with "mazuri" among the options.
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_ZURI_NA_.V.help: Act the pairs with the body: stretch for refu, crouch for fupi.
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_ZURI_NA_.V.feedback: Angalia picha tena na uchague neno linalofaa. (mabaya)
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_ZURI_NA_.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M1_MAG.error: Carries out only the first part of a two-step instruction.

example.question: Agizo: "Osha mikono, kisha uikaushe." Umefanya nini?

KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M1_MAG.cause: The child starts acting as soon as he hears the first verb and stops listening.
KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M1_MAG.reveals: The question "Agizo: "Osha mikono, kisha uikaushe." Umefanya nini?" with "anaosha mikono tu" among the options.
KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M1_MAG.help: Hold up one finger for each step while giving the instruction; the child repeats the steps before moving.
KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M1_MAG.feedback: Sikiliza agizo lote kwanza, kisha fanya hatua zote.
KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M1_MAG.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M1_MAG.error: Does the steps in the wrong order.

example.question: Agizo: "Osha mikono, kisha ule chakula." Ni nini kinatangulia?

KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M1_MAG.cause: The child does the step he wants most first; the order words kwanza and kisha are not yet noticed.
KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M1_MAG.reveals: The question "Agizo: "Osha mikono, kisha ule chakula." Ni nini kinatangulia?" with "kula chakula" among the options.
KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M1_MAG.help: Number the steps on the board with kwanza, kisha, mwishowe.
KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M1_MAG.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M1_MAG.error: Mixes a direction or action word.

example.question: Agizo: "Inua mkono wa kulia." Ni kitendo kipi sahihi?

KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M1_MAG.cause: Pairs such as kulia/kushoto and juu/chini are learnt together and swapped.
KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M1_MAG.reveals: The question "Agizo: "Inua mkono wa kulia." Ni kitendo kipi sahihi?" with "anainua mkono wa kushoto" among the options.
KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M1_MAG.help: Play "Mwalimu anasema": the teacher calls the word, the child acts it; mark the right hand with a band.
KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M1_MAG.feedback: Inua mkono wa kulia. maana yake ni anainua mkono wa kulia.
KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M1_MAG.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M1_MAG.error: Gives an instruction that leaves out what to act on, or with no polite word (Lete!).

example.question: Ni agizo lipi liko wazi na lina adabu?

KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M1_MAG.cause: The child knows what he means and does not see that the listener cannot.
KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M1_MAG.reveals: The question "Ni agizo lipi liko wazi na lina adabu?" with "Lete!" among the options.
KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M1_MAG.help: The child gives the instruction to a partner, who does exactly what was said and no more.
KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M1_MAG.feedback: Agizo zuri linasema nini kifanyike, kwa kitu gani, na kwa adabu.
KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M1_MAG.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Gives "husugua" the meaning of a word that looks or sounds like it.

example.question: Soma: "Kila asubuhi Baraka huoga kwa maji na sabuni. Yeye husugua meno na kuchana nywele. Baraka huwa safi." Neno "husugua" lina maana gani?

KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.cause: The child matches the word to a known one by its look instead of reading the sentence around it.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.reveals: The question "Soma: "Kila asubuhi Baraka huoga kwa maji na sabuni. Yeye husugua meno na kuchana nywele. Baraka huwa safi." Neno "husugua" lina maana gani?" with "husahau" among the options.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.help: Cover the word; the child says what word would fit the sentence, then uncovers it.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.feedback: Katika kifungu, "husugua" ni husafisha kwa kusugua.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Gives one detail of the passage as its message.

example.question: Ujumbe wa kifungu ni upi?
example.correct_answer: Tuoge na kusafisha mwili kila siku.

KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.cause: The detail is what the child remembers best; he has not been asked what the writer wants us to know.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.reveals: The question "Ujumbe wa kifungu ni upi?" with "Baraka huchana nywele." among the options.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.help: Ask two questions side by side: "Nini kilitokea?" and "Kifungu kinatuambia nini?"
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.feedback: Hilo ni tukio moja. Ujumbe ni: Tuoge na kusafisha mwili kila siku.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Predicts something the passage gives no clue for, without looking at the picture.

example.question: Picha inaonyesha mikono michafu ya Baraka kabla ya chakula. Atafanya nini?

KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.cause: Prediction is taken as free imagination; the child has not been shown that clues in the text and picture point the way.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.reveals: The question "Picha inaonyesha mikono michafu ya Baraka kabla ya chakula. Atafanya nini?" with "Atakula moja kwa moja." among the options.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.help: Underline the clue words and point at the picture; the guess must fit them.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.feedback: Tabiri kwa kutumia dalili za picha na za kifungu: Ataosha mikono kwa sabuni.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Retells what happened when asked for the lesson.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.cause: The lesson question sounds like a what-happened question to the child.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.reveals: The question "Tunajifunza nini kutokana na kifungu?" with "Baraka huoga asubuhi." among the options.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.help: Start the answer with "Tunajifunza kwamba tunapaswa..."
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.feedback: Funzo ni: Tunapaswa kuweka miili yetu safi.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Answers from his own life instead of from the passage.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.cause: The child links the question to what he knows from home and does not check the text.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.reveals: The question "Baraka huoga kwa nini?" with "Mimi huoga kwa maji moto." among the options.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.help: Ask the child to point at the line in the passage that gives the answer.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.feedback: Jibu liko kwenye kifungu: maji na sabuni
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G1.KUANDI.T7_KUANDIKA_MANENO_IPAS.T.error: Spells the word with the sound of his first language: "taulo" written "tauro".
KISW.G1.KUANDI.T7_KUANDIKA_MANENO_IPAS.T.cause: The child writes as he says the word; if his first language merges the two sounds, the letter is a guess.
KISW.G1.KUANDI.T7_KUANDIKA_MANENO_IPAS.T.reveals: The question "Ni tahajia ipi sahihi?" with "tauro" among the options.

KISW.G1.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_HIKI_NA_.V.help: Pair the forms on cards: huyu-hawa, yule-wale, hiki-hivi, hili-haya.
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_HIKI_NA_.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G1.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_HIKI_NA_.V.error: Uses hii for every noun (kitabu hii, mtoto hii), as in town Kiswahili.
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_HIKI_NA_.V.cause: Hii is the pointing word heard most in town speech, where the noun class is dropped.
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_HIKI_NA_.V.reveals: The question "Jaza: Kikombe ___ ni changu." with "hii" among the options.
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_HIKI_NA_.V.help: Read pairs aloud: kitabu hiki, mtoto huyu, nyumba hii; the child hears the match.
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_HIKI_NA_.V.feedback: Kitabu hiki; mtoto huyu; nyumba hii. (hiki)
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_HIKI_NA_.V.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G1.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_HIKI_NA_.V.error: Takes the plural form for the singular (miti for one tree, vitabu for one book).
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_HIKI_NA_.V.cause: The child heard the plural more often (a tree is usually among trees) and learnt it as the name.
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_HIKI_NA_.V.reveals: The question "Ni kipi ni umoja?" with "viazi hivi" among the options.
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_HIKI_NA_.V.help: Hold one object, then many; the child names each.
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_HIKI_NA_.V.feedback: Kimoja ni kitabu; vingi ni vitabu. (kiazi hiki)
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_HIKI_NA_.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..error: Says something that has nothing to do with the topic.

example.question: Mnazungumza kuhusu vyombo vya jikoni. Ni sentensi ipi inafaa?

KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..cause: The child says what is on his mind; he has not learnt that a conversation has a topic everyone keeps to.
KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..reveals: The question "Mnazungumza kuhusu vyombo vya jikoni. Ni sentensi ipi inafaa?" with "Jana nilitazama katuni nzuri." among the options.
KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..help: Put the topic picture in the middle; before speaking the child points to it.
KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..feedback: Tunazungumza kuhusu vyombo vya jikoni; sema jambo kuhusu hilo.
KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..error: Talks over others and does not wait for his turn.
KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..cause: Eagerness: the child fears he will forget his idea.
KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..reveals: The question "Mwenzako anazungumza. Unafanya nini?" with "ninaanza kuzungumza pia" among the options.
KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..help: Pass a talking object (a ball): only the one holding it speaks.
KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..feedback: Subiri zamu yako; msikilize mwenzako kwanza.
KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..error: Mixes English or Sheng words into the Kiswahili sentence.
KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..cause: At home and in town the child hears mixed speech and does not know the Kiswahili word.
KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..reveals: The question "Sema kwa Kiswahili sanifu:" with "Mama ana fridge jikoni." among the options.
KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..help: Keep a word wall: the English or Sheng word, and its Kiswahili word next to it.
KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..feedback: Kwa Kiswahili tunasema: Mama ana jokofu jikoni.
KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..error: Uses a gesture or face that does not match the words (smiling while giving sad news).

example.question: Unasema "Rafiki yangu ni mgonjwa." Uso wako unaonyesha nini?

KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..cause: The child smiles from shyness or does not link the face to the message.
KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..reveals: The question "Unasema "Rafiki yangu ni mgonjwa." Uso wako unaonyesha nini?" with "tabasamu kubwa" among the options.
KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..help: Say one sentence with three faces; the class picks the face that fits.
KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..error: Says /l/ for /r/ (or /r/ for /l/) while speaking: "rafiki" becomes "lafiki".
KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..cause: Several Kenyan first languages do not separate /l/ and /r/; the home sound carries into Kiswahili.
KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..reveals: The question "Tamka vizuri: rafiki" with "lafiki" among the options.
KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..help: Practise the pairs with a mirror: the tongue taps for r, it rests for l.
KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..feedback: Tamka "rafiki" kwa /r/: ulimi unagonga mara moja.
KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO.MAZUNGUMZO..source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Gives "sufuria" the meaning of a word that looks or sounds like it.

example.question: Soma: "Mama yuko jikoni. Anapika ugali na sukumawiki. Dada anaosha sufuria. Chakula kiko tayari." Neno "sufuria" lina maana gani?

KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.cause: The child matches the word to a known one by its look instead of reading the sentence around it.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.reveals: The question "Soma: "Mama yuko jikoni. Anapika ugali na sukumawiki. Dada anaosha sufuria. Chakula kiko tayari." Neno "sufuria" lina maana gani?" with "sufu" among the options.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.help: Cover the word; the child says what word would fit the sentence, then uncovers it.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.feedback: Katika kifungu, "sufuria" ni chombo cha kupikia.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Gives one detail of the passage as its message.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.cause: The detail is what the child remembers best; he has not been asked what the writer wants us to know.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.reveals: The question "Ujumbe wa kifungu ni upi?" with "Dada anaosha sufuria." among the options.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.help: Ask two questions side by side: "Nini kilitokea?" and "Kifungu kinatuambia nini?"
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.feedback: Hilo ni tukio moja. Ujumbe ni: Familia hushirikiana kupika chakula.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Predicts something the passage gives no clue for, without looking at the picture.

example.question: Picha inaonyesha meza yenye sahani. Familia itafanya nini?

KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.cause: Prediction is taken as free imagination; the child has not been shown that clues in the text and picture point the way.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.reveals: The question "Picha inaonyesha meza yenye sahani. Familia itafanya nini?" with "Italala." among the options.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.help: Underline the clue words and point at the picture; the guess must fit them.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.feedback: Tabiri kwa kutumia dalili za picha na za kifungu: Itakula chakula pamoja.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Retells what happened when asked for the lesson.

example.question: Tunajifunza nini kutokana na kifungu?
example.correct_answer: Tunapaswa kuwasaidia wazazi kazi za jikoni.

KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.cause: The lesson question sounds like a what-happened question to the child.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.reveals: The question "Tunajifunza nini kutokana na kifungu?" with "Mama anapika ugali." among the options.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.help: Start the answer with "Tunajifunza kwamba tunapaswa..."
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.feedback: Funzo ni: Tunapaswa kuwasaidia wazazi kazi za jikoni.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Answers from his own life instead of from the passage.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.cause: The child links the question to what he knows from home and does not check the text.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.reveals: The question "Mama anapika nini?" with "Mama yangu anapika wali." among the options.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.help: Ask the child to point at the line in the passage that gives the answer.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.feedback: Jibu liko kwenye kifungu: ugali na sukumawiki
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G1.KUANDI.T9_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_.K.error: Lists the things in the picture (mti, mtoto, mbwa) instead of writing sentences about what is happening.

example.question: Ni kipi ni kifungu kuhusu picha?
example.correct_answer: Mtoto anacheza na mbwa chini ya mti.

KISW.G1.KUANDI.T9_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_.K.cause: Naming pictures was the earlier task; the child has not moved to sentences.
KISW.G1.KUANDI.T9_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_.K.reveals: The question "Ni kipi ni kifungu kuhusu picha?" with "mti. mtoto. mbwa." among the options.
KISW.G1.KUANDI.T9_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_.K.help: Ask "Nani? Anafanya nini? Wapi?" for each part of the picture.
KISW.G1.KUANDI.T9_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_.K.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G1.KUANDI.T9_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_.K.error: Writes no title, or a title that does not fit the writing.

example.question: Kichwa kipi kinafaa insha kuhusu jikoni?

KISW.G1.KUANDI.T9_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_.K.cause: The child thinks the word "insha" or the date is the title.
KISW.G1.KUANDI.T9_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_.K.reveals: The question "Kichwa kipi kinafaa insha kuhusu jikoni?" with "Insha" among the options.
KISW.G1.KUANDI.T9_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_.K.help: Read the finished writing and ask: what is it about in three words?
KISW.G1.KUANDI.T9_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_.K.feedback: Kichwa kinasema insha inahusu nini: Jikoni Kwetu.
KISW.G1.KUANDI.T9_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_.K.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G1.KUANDI.T9_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_.K.error: Joins every sentence with "na halafu", so the writing is one long sentence.

example.question: Ni lipi limeandikwa vizuri?
example.wrong_answer: Tuliamka na halafu tukaoga na halafu tukaenda sokoni.
example.correct_answer: Tuliamka asubuhi. Tulioga, kisha tukaenda sokoni.

KISW.G1.KUANDI.T9_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_.K.cause: Spoken retelling joins events with na halafu; the child writes as he talks.
KISW.G1.KUANDI.T9_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_.K.reveals: The question "Ni lipi limeandikwa vizuri?" with "Tuliamka na halafu tukaoga na halafu tukaenda sokoni." among the options.
KISW.G1.KUANDI.T9_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_.K.help: Give a word bank: kwanza, kisha, baadaye, mwishowe; one per sentence.
KISW.G1.KUANDI.T9_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_.K.feedback: Tumia kikomo na maneno kama kisha, baadaye.
KISW.G1.KUANDI.T9_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_.K.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G1.KUANDI.T9_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_.K.error: Slips from one tense to another in the middle of the writing (past -li- to present -na-, or habitual hu- to past).

example.question: Ni lipi sahihi?
example.wrong_answer: Mama alipika ugali. Dada anaosha vyombo.
example.correct_answer: Mama alipika ugali. Dada aliosha vyombo.

KISW.G1.KUANDI.T9_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_.K.cause: The child thinks of the events as he writes and the tense of the moment comes in.
KISW.G1.KUANDI.T9_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_.K.reveals: The question "Ni lipi sahihi?" with "Mama alipika ugali. Dada anaosha vyombo." among the options.
KISW.G1.KUANDI.T9_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_.K.help: Underline every verb; all the tense markers should match.
KISW.G1.KUANDI.T9_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_.K.feedback: Tumia wakati mmoja katika insha nzima.
KISW.G1.KUANDI.T9_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_.K.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G1.KUANDI.T9_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_.K.error: Puts English or Sheng words into the Kiswahili writing.
KISW.G1.KUANDI.T9_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_.K.cause: The child does not know the Kiswahili word and fills the gap with the one he knows.
KISW.G1.KUANDI.T9_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_.K.reveals: The question "Sahihisha:" with "Mama anapika rice." among the options.
KISW.G1.KUANDI.T9_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_.K.help: Keep a word bank of theme words on the board before writing.
KISW.G1.KUANDI.T9_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_.K.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G1.SARUFI.T9_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_Y.V.error: Picks a thing word as the action word (in "Mama anapika ugali" chooses ugali).

example.question: Neno la kitendo katika "Mama anapika ugali" ni lipi?

KISW.G1.SARUFI.T9_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_Y.V.cause: The child looks for the word he knows best, often the thing he can picture.
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T9_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_Y.V.reveals: The question "Neno la kitendo katika "Mama anapika ugali" ni lipi?" with "ugali" among the options.
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T9_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_Y.V.help: Act the sentence: the word you can do is the action word.
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T9_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_Y.V.feedback: Neno la kitendo ni lile tunaloweza kulifanya: anapika. (anapika)
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T9_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_Y.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G1.SARUFI.T9_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_Y.V.error: Writes the bare verb with no person marker (Mama pika ugali for Mama anapika ugali).
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T9_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_Y.V.cause: The command form (pika!) is heard most at home and the child uses it in every sentence.
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T9_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_Y.V.reveals: The question "Ni lipi sahihi?" with "Mama pika ugali." among the options.
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T9_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_Y.V.help: Colour the a-na- in front of the verb; read the sentence with and without it.
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T9_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_Y.V.feedback: Tunasema "Mama anapika", si "Mama pika". (Mama anapika ugali.)
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T9_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_Y.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G1.SARUFI.T9_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_Y.V.error: Gives the verb the marker of the wrong person or number (Mama wanapika; Watoto anacheza).
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T9_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_Y.V.cause: The child has not linked the start of the verb to who is doing it.
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T9_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_Y.V.reveals: The question "Jaza: Watoto ___ (kula) chakula." with "anakula" among the options.
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T9_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_Y.V.help: Point at the doer, then at the start of the verb; they must match (mmoja a-, wengi wa-).
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T9_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_Y.V.feedback: Mtu mmoja: anapika; watu wengi: wanapika. (wanakula)
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T9_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_Y.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G1.SARUFI.T9_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_Y.V.error: Takes a describing word for an action word (in "Sahani ni safi" chooses safi as the action).

example.question: Neno la kitendo katika "Dada anaosha sahani safi" ni lipi?

KISW.G1.SARUFI.T9_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_Y.V.cause: Any word after the noun looks like what the noun "does".
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T9_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_Y.V.reveals: The question "Neno la kitendo katika "Dada anaosha sahani safi" ni lipi?" with "safi" among the options.
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T9_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_Y.V.help: Ask "Inafanya nini?" If there is no answer, there is no action word.
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T9_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_Y.V.feedback: Neno la kitendo linaonyesha kinachofanywa, kama "anaosha". (anaosha)
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T9_MATUMIZI_YA_MANENO_Y.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

example.question: Mwalimu anasema "dhahabu". Neno lipi limetamkwa vizuri?

KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.cause: Many Kenyan first languages have no /dh/, or do not separate it from /z/; the child puts in the home sound.
KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.reveals: The question "Mwalimu anasema "dhahabu". Neno lipi limetamkwa vizuri?" with "zahabu" among the options.
KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.help: Say the two side by side, slowly, watching the mouth; the child holds up a card for the sound he hears.
KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.cause: /ch/ and /sh/ are close; a first language with only one of them puts that one in both places.
KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.reveals: The question "Neno lipi limetamkwa vizuri?" with "shenga" among the options.
KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.help: Contrast the two with a mirror and a hand before the mouth; the child says which he hears.
KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.error: Drops part of the target sound, so "ngoma" becomes "goma".

example.question: Neno "ngoma" limeandikwa au kutamkwa vipi kwa usahihi?

KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.cause: The second part of the sound (the w or y glide, or the soft nasal) is quick and quiet; the child does not hear it and leaves it out.
KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.reveals: The question "Neno "ngoma" limeandikwa au kutamkwa vipi kwa usahihi?" with "goma" among the options.
KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.help: Stretch the syllable slowly (p-y-a), then say it fast; the child copies.
KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.feedback: Sikiliza tena: "ngoma". Usiache sehemu ya sauti.
KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.error: Splits "ngoma" by letters rather than by syllables (each Kiswahili syllable ends in a vowel).
KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.cause: The child has learnt letters one by one and has not been shown that a syllable is a sound that ends in a vowel.
KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.reveals: The question "Neno "ngoma" lina silabi zipi?" with "n-g-o-m-a" among the options.
KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.help: Clap the word: one clap per vowel; the consonants go with the vowel after them.
KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.feedback: Kila silabi ya Kiswahili huishia kwa irabu: ngo-ma.
KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.error: Picks a word with no target sound when asked for one that has it.
KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.cause: The child looks at the first letter or the picture, not at the sound.
KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.reveals: The question "Ni neno lipi lina sauti /ny/, /dh/, /th/, /ch/, /gh/, /ng/, /ng'/?" with "mpira" among the options.
KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.help: Underline the target sound in each word on the card before choosing.
KISW.G1.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.error: Reads the target word wrongly: "chenga" as "shenga".
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.cause: The child reads the letters with the sounds of his first language, or adds a vowel to break the cluster.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.reveals: The question "Neno "chenga" linasomwa vipi?" with "shenga" among the options.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.help: Pick out the target words before reading; practise them on cards, then read the passage.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.error: Reads word by word or syllable by syllable, so the sentence has no meaning when heard.

example.question: Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Tunacheza ngoma uwanjani."?

KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.cause: The child is still decoding each word; he has not yet read a group of words as one piece.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.reveals: The question "Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Tunacheza ngoma uwanjani."?" with "Tunacheza ... ngoma ... uwanjani." among the options.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.help: Echo reading: the teacher reads a phrase, the child repeats it in one breath.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.feedback: Soma maneno kwa pamoja kama unavyozungumza.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.error: Reads so softly (or so loudly, shouting) that the class cannot follow.

example.question: Unaposoma mbele ya darasa, sauti yako inafaa kuwa vipi?
example.wrong_answer: ya chini ili nisikosee mbele ya wenzangu
example.correct_answer: ya kusikika na wote darasani, bila kupiga kelele

KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.cause: Shyness, or the belief that reading well means reading loud.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.reveals: The question "Unaposoma mbele ya darasa, sauti yako inafaa kuwa vipi?" with "ya chini ili nisikosee mbele ya wenzangu" among the options.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.help: Stand the reader at the front and a listener at the back: the listener raises a hand when he hears every word.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.feedback: Soma kwa sauti inayosikika na wote, bila kupiga kelele.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.error: Reads as fast as possible and thinks the fastest reader is the best.

example.question: Kasi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu ni ipi?
example.correct_answer: kasi ya kuzungumza, karibu maneno 30 kwa dakika

KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.cause: Reading races in class reward speed; nobody asked whether the listeners understood.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.reveals: The question "Kasi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu ni ipi?" with "haraka iwezekanavyo" among the options.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.help: Time two readings, one very fast and one at speaking pace; the listeners answer one question after each.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.feedback: Kasi ifaayo ni ya kuzungumza: si haraka mno, si polepole mno.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.error: Reads a question in the flat voice of a statement and runs on through the koma and kikomo.

example.question: Sentensi "Je, umeona nyota?" inasomwa vipi?
example.wrong_answer: kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida
example.correct_answer: sauti hupanda mwishoni kwa sababu ni swali

KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.cause: The child looks at the words and not at the marks.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.reveals: The question "Sentensi "Je, umeona nyota?" inasomwa vipi?" with "kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida" among the options.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.help: Read the same words three ways (. ? !); the child points at the mark that fits each reading; clap at each kikomo.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.feedback: Kiulizi (?) hupandisha sauti mwishoni; simama kidogo kwenye koma na kikomo.
KISW.G1.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G1.KUANDI.T10_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_..error: Lists the things in the picture (mti, mtoto, mbwa) instead of writing sentences about what is happening.

example.question: Ni kipi ni kifungu kuhusu picha?
example.correct_answer: Mtoto anacheza na mbwa chini ya mti.

KISW.G1.KUANDI.T10_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_..cause: Naming pictures was the earlier task; the child has not moved to sentences.
KISW.G1.KUANDI.T10_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_..reveals: The question "Ni kipi ni kifungu kuhusu picha?" with "mti. mtoto. mbwa." among the options.
KISW.G1.KUANDI.T10_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_..help: Ask "Nani? Anafanya nini? Wapi?" for each part of the picture.
KISW.G1.KUANDI.T10_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_..source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G1.KUANDI.T10_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_..error: Writes no title, or a title that does not fit the writing.

example.question: Kichwa kipi kinafaa insha kuhusu michezo?

KISW.G1.KUANDI.T10_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_..cause: The child thinks the word "insha" or the date is the title.
KISW.G1.KUANDI.T10_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_..reveals: The question "Kichwa kipi kinafaa insha kuhusu michezo?" with "Insha" among the options.
KISW.G1.KUANDI.T10_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_..help: Read the finished writing and ask: what is it about in three words?
KISW.G1.KUANDI.T10_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_..feedback: Kichwa kinasema insha inahusu nini: Michezo Shuleni.
KISW.G1.KUANDI.T10_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_..source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G1.KUANDI.T10_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_..error: Joins every sentence with "na halafu", so the writing is one long sentence.

example.question: Ni lipi limeandikwa vizuri?
example.wrong_answer: Tuliamka na halafu tukaoga na halafu tukaenda sokoni.
example.correct_answer: Tuliamka asubuhi. Tulioga, kisha tukaenda sokoni.

KISW.G1.KUANDI.T10_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_..cause: Spoken retelling joins events with na halafu; the child writes as he talks.
KISW.G1.KUANDI.T10_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_..reveals: The question "Ni lipi limeandikwa vizuri?" with "Tuliamka na halafu tukaoga na halafu tukaenda sokoni." among the options.
KISW.G1.KUANDI.T10_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_..help: Give a word bank: kwanza, kisha, baadaye, mwishowe; one per sentence.
KISW.G1.KUANDI.T10_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_..feedback: Tumia kikomo na maneno kama kisha, baadaye.
KISW.G1.KUANDI.T10_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_..source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G1.KUANDI.T10_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_..error: Slips from one tense to another in the middle of the writing (past -li- to present -na-, or habitual hu- to past).

example.question: Ni lipi sahihi?
example.wrong_answer: Jana tulicheza mpira. Juma anafunga bao.
example.correct_answer: Jana tulicheza mpira. Juma alifunga bao.

KISW.G1.KUANDI.T10_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_..cause: The child thinks of the events as he writes and the tense of the moment comes in.
KISW.G1.KUANDI.T10_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_..reveals: The question "Ni lipi sahihi?" with "Jana tulicheza mpira. Juma anafunga bao." among the options.
KISW.G1.KUANDI.T10_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_..help: Underline every verb; all the tense markers should match.
KISW.G1.KUANDI.T10_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_..feedback: Tumia wakati mmoja katika insha nzima.
KISW.G1.KUANDI.T10_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_..source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G1.KUANDI.T10_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_..error: Puts English or Sheng words into the Kiswahili writing.
KISW.G1.KUANDI.T10_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_..cause: The child does not know the Kiswahili word and fills the gap with the one he knows.
KISW.G1.KUANDI.T10_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_..reveals: The question "Sahihisha:" with "Tulicheza football." among the options.
KISW.G1.KUANDI.T10_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_..help: Keep a word bank of theme words on the board before writing.
KISW.G1.KUANDI.T10_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_..feedback: Kwa Kiswahili: Tulicheza mpira wa miguu.
KISW.G1.KUANDI.T10_KIFUNGU_KUTOKANA_NA_..source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G1.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.error: Gives the negative of the verb (hafungui) instead of its opposite action (funga).
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.cause: The child thinks "opposite" means "not doing it".
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.reveals: The question "Kinyume cha "anza" (mchezo) ni?" with "usianze" among the options.
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.help: Act it: fungua the door, then funga it; not doing anything is not the opposite.
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.feedback: Kinyume cha kitendo ni kitendo kingine: fungua - funga. (maliza)
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G1.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.error: Makes an opposite by adding -ua to any verb (keti -> ketua).
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.cause: Fungua/funga and vaa/vua show a pattern, and the child uses it everywhere.
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.reveals: The question "Kinyume cha "keti" ni?" with "ketua" among the options.
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.help: Sort pairs into two piles: made with -ua (funga-fungua) and different words (keti-simama).
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G1.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.error: Gives a word of the same meaning as the opposite (simama - inuka).
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.cause: The child knows the words go together but not that they mean the same.
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.reveals: The question "Kinyume cha "ingia" ni?" with "jiunga" among the options.
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.help: Act both words: if the action is the same, it is not the opposite.
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G1.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.error: Gives a place or thing word as the opposite of an action (ingia - nje).
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.cause: Ingia and nje are heard together in "ingia ndani, toka nje".
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.reveals: The question "Kinyume cha "panda" (mti) ni?" with "chini" among the options.
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.help: Ask "Ni kitendo?" before accepting: the opposite of an action is an action.
KISW.G1.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher
